findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: answer_ticket, make_resume, my_tickets, support_inbox, read_ticket, my_articles, open_ticket, update_article · Private data: install_product, make_resume, draft_team_lesson, search_lessons, draft_lesson, team_lessons, preflight, view_product, read_article, read_product_file, open_ticket, get_lesson · Public sink: answer_ticket, update_profile, add_article_image, preflight, reply_to_ticket, publish_article, open_ticket · Destructive: install_product, delete_article, search_lessons, preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: answer_ticket, make_resume, my_tickets, support_inbox, read_ticket, my_articles, open_ticket, update_article · Private data: install_product, make_resume, draft_team_lesson, search_lessons, draft_lesson, team_lessons, preflight, view_product, read_article, read_product_file, open_ticket, get_lesson · Public sink: answer_ticket, update_profile, add_article_image, preflight, reply_to_ticket, publish_article, open_ticket · Destructive: install_product, delete_article, search_lessons, preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
